summary_en: 5,000,000 shares (10.2% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be cancelled effective 2026-08-31. Post-cancellation issued shares: 43,969,096.
title_en: Notice of Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: TOW Co., Ltd. (ticker 4767, TSE Standard) announced on 2026-08-07 that its board of directors resolved to cancel 5,000,000 treasury shares effective 2026-08-31, pursuant to Companies Act Article 178. The cancellation represents 10.2% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury). Following the cancellation, the company's total issued shares will be 43,969,096.
